mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reflex pathways to the body was most worthwhile: the planned paired views connect the sensors to a recognizable task, keeping a friend in view while turning.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor assemblies was straightforward but added little explanation beyond placing them together.

surprise.text: The weighted membranes respond both to gravity and changes in straight-line motion; the planned comparison helps distinguish those situations.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, though the terms “otolith” and “vestibular” appeared without explanation. The offered compatible combinations guided the sequence rather than requiring me to discover it.

continue.text: I would probably continue: the final head-turn example gives the anatomical construction a useful payoff, although several intermediate fittings felt predictable.
